# Jamatia Islamic Centre

A place for prayer, Islamic learning and community life at 179–183 Woodlands Road,
Sparkhill, Birmingham B11 4ER.

## Public pages

- [Prayer times](/prayer-times): Today’s prayer start and congregation times.
- [Monthly timetable](/prayer-times/monthly): Prayer times and timetable downloads.
- [Services](/services): Find guidance for centre services and enquiries.
- [Education](/education): Adult classes, Madrassah and enrolment information.
- [Madrassah](/madrassah): Pupil learning and information for parents.
- [Youth](/youth): Learning, activities and opportunities for young people.
- [Masjid project](/projects): Project areas and published updates.
- [Donate](/donate): Bank transfer details and public fundraising pages.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, telephone, email and an enquiry form.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How website information is used.

Current availability and arrangements should be confirmed with the centre.
